verified_fact: Bhasmasura pleased Shiva with tapas and received a boon: anyone he touched on the head would turn to ash. He immediately tried to touch Shiva's head. Shiva fled and Vishnu appeared as Mohini to trick Bhasmasura into touching his own head.

description:
Bhasmasura Ne Shiv Ko Hi Jalaane Ki Koshi Ki! 😱

🔱 Bhasmasura boon turned against Shiva Mohini trick

Bhasmasura pleased Shiva with tapas and received a boon: anyone he touched on the head would turn to ash. He immediately tried to touch Shiva's head. Shiva fled and Vishnu appeared as Mohini to trick Bhasmasura into touching his own head.

👉 Kya kabhi aisa wish hua jo khud par hi ulta pad gaya?
